description: Kirdo III, also referred to simply as Kirdo, was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, that was the homeworld of the Kitonak species On the way back from Rodia, Luke Skywalker forged a new hyperspace lane between Kirdo and Orto Plutonia.
lead_paragraphs: Kirdo III, also referred to simply as Kirdo, was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, that was the homeworld of the Kitonak species On the way back from Rodia, Luke Skywalker forged a new hyperspace lane between Kirdo and Orto Plutonia.

Chindinkalu plants were native to Kirdo III. The Kitonak musician Droopy McCool used a hollow chindinkalu plant to create his Chindinkalu flute which he played at Jabba's Palace in 4 ABY during the Rescue of Han Solo.
